vision.title: Configure photo recognition
vision.description: Configure an OpenAI-compatible vision provider for this meter. Leave the provider address empty to disable photo recognition. Model and prompt are stored independently with this meter.

data_description.vision_compress_image: Enabled: converts the photo to JPEG, limits its longest edge to 1600 pixels and its output size to 2 MiB, and removes embedded metadata. Disabled: sends an original JPEG, PNG, or WebP file unchanged up to 20 MiB, including embedded metadata. Enabled by default.

reconfigure.title: Configure photo recognition
reconfigure.description: Changes apply only to this meter. Leave the API token empty to retain the stored token, or select Remove stored API token to delete it.
